notes.title: Upates 1st August
notes.content:
It's been a while, huh? Well I'm back with some new fixes and improvements for the game.

Small, but something to sink your teeth in to:

[list]
[*] New Out of bounds fixes (If you decide to go crazy with the ragdoll physics you wont be flying forever)
[*] Added new music to the game, to snazz it up a lil bit 🎶
[*] Removed some maps and updated a little
[*] Unlimited Timer, you can now play up to an HOUR on the maps ⏲️
[/list]

Bless you,
Goobster.

notes.title: KING OF THE GRILL + Other goodies
notes.content:
Hi there Dadlympians!

Here's a little list of the most recent things going on with Dadlympics!

First off, we've had a lot of new people trying the game out and from what I've seen they've been having a BLAST playing this game, so more updates coming!

[h1]TRANSLATIONS:[/h1]

I've added translations to the game so everyone can enjoy the game equally! These languages include:
- Swedish
- German
- Spanish
- Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Arabic

[h1]NEW MAP - KING OF THE GRILL[/h1]
This new map is for the King of the hill gamemode, and it's a cute little backyard where you battle for the grill.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VLmG097.png[/img]

[h1]DAD NOISES[/h1]
The dad noises have been updated and by pressing 'B' you can burp and sneeze now!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kP6WclO.png[/img]

[h1]SMALL MODEL UPDATE[/h1]
The cigarettes were a bit boring the first time around, so I decided to improve them!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bQgurZN.png[/img]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed rubber banding issues, improved the networking code.
- Fixed round over issues where you got soft-locked in the game.
- Better Crashalytics.
- Patch for round stability
- Hotfixes for multiplayer stability

notes.title: NEW GAMEMODE RELEASE - KING OF THE HILL
notes.content:
Hey there Dadlympians!

We've had an amazing week so far! A ton of people have tried the game and given feedback, and I've listened carefully.

[b]First change[/b];

There was many people who wanted a [b]king of the hill gamemode[/b], so I made one:

It works like any version of King of the hill, but this time with wonky ragdolls and a [b]LETHAL knockout[/b], so go try it out!

[b]Second change[/b];

I've also added a better system to get up with the character (There has been a lot of feedback), so I would like to say it's perfect at this point!

With those updates there's also been some optimization and hot fixes for some issues.

These updates will be released before the livestream! So I hope you stay tuned.

Have a good one!
- Gooby
